strings.crashReport.issueBody:
## Symptom
%1 — %2

## Steps to reproduce
To be completed (do not publish private data).

## Private report
%3
Access restricted to the Monarch team. Expires no later than 90 days after submission.

Diagnostics and attachments are not copied into this public issue.

strings.crashReport.waitBeforeClosing: Wait for the operation to finish before closing.
